description: Systematic stop-the-line root-cause debugging for deterministic failures with a clear signal: a failing test, broken build, readable stack trace, or a reliably reproducible behavior mismatch. Do not use for greenfield feature work, live production outages (use incident-response), or hard, intermittent, or performance bugs that need a constructed feedback loop (use diagnose).
